summary.text: Ted Japp is a candidate for the Nebraska Legislature, District 16, in the November 3, 2026 nonpartisan general election, facing Cindy Chatt.
He served on the Papio-Missouri River Natural Resources District Board, Subdistrict 1, from 2017 to January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Japp was unopposed for re-election to the Papio-Missouri River Natural Resources District Board, Subdistrict 1, in the November 3, 2020 general election.
He did not run for re-election in 2024 and left the board on January 9, 2025.
In the May 12, 2026 nonpartisan primary for Legislature District 16, Japp finished first with 5,198 votes, or 63.0 percent.
